youtube.title: Whatever She Draws Comes Alive 😳
youtube.description:
Anything Mia draws comes to life, exactly as it's drawn. Her dog is four sticks. Her bike has square wheels. Then Leo, the class artist, grabs her pencil and draws a perfect lion... and it roars.

What would you draw first? Tell us in the comments.
